compatibility_notes: H3 is a gate ledger: it records the P1 same-task science evidence state and never upgrades an unexecuted combination to PASS. A scenario result, a scientific claim status, and H3 closure remain three separate records (Q09).

The same-task matrix has exactly one logical row set (CLI, HTTP/Workbench, MCP/DSH) and every entry must resolve to the one first-submit task id and attempt. A fresh submit through any entry that yields a second task id is a hard failure, not an alternate observation.

The product schema, manifest generation, manifest digest, task result and scientific validation are shared fields: if any entry reads a different value the matrix is rejected even when the task id and attempt match.

Every combination cell uses only PASS|FAIL|NOT_VERIFIED. With the platform Local/LSF records, B07 deadlines, B10 three-entry sample and C15 same-task-browser-live absent, all six cells are NOT_VERIFIED with the exact missing item.
Active workflows are checked against the frozen catalog order and the fifteen-row task-compatibility matrix; A-13 edits no src/acp, src/acp_services, workflow, CI, version or pyproject file.
